summary.text: Jenn Jennings is the Republican candidate for Connecticut State Senate District 4 in the November 3, 2026 general election, in which she faces incumbent MD Rahman (D / Working Families Party).
She is a Realtor, the executive director of the Connecticut Heating & Cooling Contractors Association and a member of the Glastonbury Board of Education.

paragraphs.text: Jenn Jennings graduated from Stamford High School and earned a bachelor's degree from Eastern Connecticut State University in 2004.

In a Ballotpedia survey, Jennings described herself as a wife and mother of three who has worked for more than twenty years alongside Connecticut's skilled trades workforce, advocating for apprenticeships, career pathways and small businesses.
She said her campaign is built on the themes "People Over Politics" and "Outcomes Over Optics," with a focus on transparency, accountability and protecting public dollars.
